display.purpose: Hero numerals and marketing headline only.

body.purpose: The dominant UI text size — labels, buttons, values.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Reserved for small floating elements (tooltips/popovers) if introduced; not yet used.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Modal panels — the only components that float above page flow.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Default transition duration (input border-color, tab underline).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Standard easing; used for modal entrance motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default solid CTA — black pill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1a1a1a; color: #ffffff; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #333333; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5B3FFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #c8c8c8; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline pill — used for lower-emphasis actions alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1a1a1a; border: 1.5px solid #d8d8d8; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f5f5f5; border-color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5B3FFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No border, no fill — low-emphasis inline actions (cancel inside a form row, icon-only edit/delete).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: none; border: none; color: #888888; padding: 5px 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5B3FFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field — also the base style for native <select> and the custom listbox trigger.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid #c8c8c8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #1a1a1a; background: #ffffff; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #5B3FFF; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(91, 63, 255, 0.18); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, bordered container — no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #888888; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; }

components.name: Modal Panel
components.description: The only elevated surface in the system — floats above a dark scrim.
components.css: .ds-modal-scrim { position: relative; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); padding: 40px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-modal-panel { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.16); padding: 28px 24px 24px; max-width: 360px; } .ds-modal-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; }

components.name: Navigation Tabs
components.description: Underline tabs — the only navigation pattern in the system. Active state: black text/underline, weight 600.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; } .ds-tab { background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 14px 0; margin-right: 28px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: #888888; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: #1a1a1a; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Pill-shaped, no-gap segmented control for binary/ternary filters (not navigation) — active segment gets a solid fill.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-segment { background: transparent; border: none; padding: 7px 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #1a1a1a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment-active { background: #1a1a1a; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview:
Ledger looks like what it is: a precise, personal financial record, not a SaaS product performing enthusiasm. The system is grayscale-first — ink, surface, and border tones do almost all of the work — with exactly two colors allowed to speak: an electric violet (#5B3FFF) reserved for interactive/focus states, and a settled green (#0F9D58) reserved for savings and positive money. Every other surface stays black, white, and gray on purpose. Money itself gets the one typographic flourish in the system — tabular monospace numerals — while everything else stays in a plain, restrained sans-serif.

The system did not arrive fully tokenized: dashboard components are built with CSS Modules that consistently reference globals.css custom properties, while the app shell and marketing surfaces use Tailwind utilities plus inline style objects with hand-typed hex values that happen to match the same palette. Both are legitimate, coexisting conventions in this codebase.
keyCharacteristics: Grayscale-dominant surface; color is earned, not decorative
Black pill buttons and underline tabs, not filled/rounded-rect tabs
One purple accent for all interactive/focus states; one green accent for savings/positive money
Tabular monospace numerals for money; plain sans-serif for everything else
Flat by default; shadows appear only on things that float above the page (modals)
No icon library in use — every icon is a hand-authored inline SVG

rules.name: The Two-Color Rule
rules.body: Only violet and green are allowed to be color in an otherwise grayscale interface. Violet means interactive/focus. Green means savings/positive money. A new UI color is a decision, not a default.

rules.name: The Mono-Money Rule
rules.body: Any rendered monetary amount uses JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums. Never render a dollar figure in Inter.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means this is floating above the page. Anything still in normal document flow stays flat and uses border + background for separation instead.

dos: Do keep color to exactly two jobs: violet for interactive/focus, green for savings/positive money.
Do render every monetary amount in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do use pill radius for buttons/toggles, 8-12px rounded rectangles for cards/inputs/modals.
Do use borders and background, not shadows, for depth on anything still in page flow.
Do use underline tabs for primary navigation; reserve filled/pill segments for filters.
Do match the established focus treatment exactly on any new interactive control.
Do follow whichever authoring convention the surrounding code already uses.
donts: Don't introduce a third UI color without treating it as a deliberate decision.
Don't use ink-secondary (#888) for small (<14px) must-read text — it fails contrast at that size.
Don't add a drop shadow to a card, button, or tile that's still in normal page flow.
Don't invent a new destructive-red — converge on --color-danger-text (#c0392b).
Don't hardcode #5B3FFF as a fresh literal if it can reference --color-primary-600 instead.
Don't add lucide-react icons alongside hand-authored SVGs without deciding to migrate the whole icon set.
Don't use @headlessui/react for a new modal — the established pattern is a hand-rolled overlay + Framer Motion AnimatePresence.
